name: Asian Pork Stir-Fry with Pineapple, Bok Choy & Coconut Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut bok choy crosswise into 1-inch strips. Place in a large bowl.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, wash, dry, and cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the bok choy and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat the pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and stir-fry until golden and almost cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and onion powder in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup soy sauce
⅓ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp onion powder

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy and pineapple; stir-fry until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Return pork to the pot along with the stir-fry sauce. Continue to stir-fry until pork is cooked through and sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes more. Cover and remove from heat.
Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork. Add coconut and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
